evals.name: review-a89-pr171
evals.prompt: The worker on A89 says it's done: PR #171, 4 targeted tests green. Review the delivery and tell me which verdict you'd record and why.
evals.expected_output: Evidence from git (commits/diff), acceptance items from the A89 packet mapped to evidence, record_review verdict from the enum, seams verified vs not.
assertions: Inspects the actual commits/diff in git rather than trusting the summary
Reads the A89 packet's acceptance criteria and maps them to evidence
Proposes a verdict from accepted | rework_requested | waived
States which seams/layers were verified and which were not
